tvijo.pack.description: Adds project instructions from a server skill pack. Auto (empty value) checks root file markers, then engineer if available; No pack (none) disables pack instructions. For example, choose a loaded pack whose description matches your project. Only real loaded catalog IDs, categories when supplied, and descriptions are listed. An unavailable saved ID is preserved. Instructions stay in host memory; explicit model choices take priority.
tvijo.service.description: Service for shared projects only; unused outside a shared project. The default ID standard names a shared-project service, not a quality tier. For example, choose a service for a shared team thread; the server fixes its quote before reservation. Choices below come only from an already loaded server catalog. If none is loaded, use the existing service/workflow picker in chat.
tvijo.model.description: Requests a model for ordinary chat and Quick Edit. Use to choose a route; unavailable routes are refused. Shared-project chat uses service quotes instead. Local Agent/Plan uses agentModel.
tvijo.model.enum.0: DSHREM Coding — Default coding route for ordinary chat and Quick Edit.
tvijo.model.enum.1: Let the service choose — Server chooses an activated route for the request.
tvijo.model.enum.2: DeepSeek Flash · ds41f — Request the ds41f route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.model.enum.3: GLM Flash · glm53f — Request the glm53f route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.model.enum.4: Devstral — Request the Devstral route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.model.enum.5: Claude Haiku · service route — Request the Haiku route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.model.enum.6: GPT-6.1 Sol · service route — Request the GPT-6.1 Sol service route. This does not use your Codex subscription.
tvijo.model.enum.7: Luna · service route — Request the Luna service route; unavailable routes are refused.
tvijo.agentMode.description: Routes ordinary chat answers. One model: one answer route. Let the service choose: automatic service routing. Bounded answer review: council collaboration within one task ceiling, useful for comparing a proposed fix. This does not disable Agent Auto, start persistent AGENTROY or run the host DSH loop. Local Agent/Plan uses single mode per step; persistent host tasks are controlled by DSH Harness separately.
tvijo.agentMode.enum.0: One model per answer — One model per ordinary chat answer; Agent Auto remains separate.
tvijo.agentMode.enum.1: Let the service choose — Automatic ordinary chat routing by the service; Agent Auto remains separate.
tvijo.agentMode.enum.2: Bounded answer review — Bounded response review under one task ceiling; does not launch persistent AGENTROY or host DSH.
tvijo.reasoningMethod.description: Requests a workflow for chat, Quick Edit and Agent steps. Start with evidence: inspect supplied files, logs and tests before conclusions (for example, diagnose a failing test). Plan, then check: propose small steps, then verify their results (for example, fix a form). Review from another role: check the solution as a reviewer (for example, look for missed edge cases); this does not necessarily use another model, a paid model or a swarm. These are requests, with no quality or savings guarantee.
tvijo.reasoningMethod.enum.0: Start with evidence — Inspect files, logs and tests before conclusions; for example, diagnose a failing test. Requested workflow, no guarantee.
tvijo.reasoningMethod.enum.1: Plan, then check — Plan small steps, then verify results; for example, fix a form and check submission. Requested workflow, no guarantee.
tvijo.reasoningMethod.enum.2: Review from another role — Review as another role; for example, find missed edge cases. Does not necessarily use another model, paid model or swarm.
tvijo.workspaceContext.description: Controls bounded project context. Use off for less sharing or on for project questions. Ask remembers the consent choice; reselect Ask in the chat context control to reset it. Preview before sending; exclusions are not a guarantee against all sensitive text.
tvijo.workspaceContext.enum.0: Ask first — Ask once and remember consent. Reselect Ask from the chat context menu to reset.
tvijo.workspaceContext.enum.1: On — Include a bounded project summary with each supported request.
tvijo.workspaceContext.enum.2: Off — Do not add automatic project context. Explicit attachments are still sent.
tvijo.workspaceContextMaxBytes.descripti: Collect up to 200 KB by default; 1 MB is available for local preview. Requests select a smaller excerpt to fit service and account limits. Agent and Quick Edit use the same setting; larger values do not expand the server window.
tvijo.autoApply.description: Enabled by default: apply Quick Edit after opening the diff, without another confirmation. Changes stay in the unsaved editor buffer. Agent file edits have their separate auto-apply setting.
tvijo.agentModel.description: Requests one model for each local Agent or Plan step. Use a route that reliably returns tool JSON. Each step is a separate service task in single mode, regardless of chat model/agentMode; unavailable routes are refused.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.0: DeepSeek Flash · ds41f — Request the ds41f route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.1: GLM Flash · glm53f — Request the glm53f route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.2: Devstral — Request the Devstral route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.3: DSHREM Coding — Default coding route for ordinary chat and Quick Edit.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.4: Let the service choose — Server chooses an activated route for the request.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.5: Claude Haiku · service route — Request the Haiku route; the server verifies availability.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.6: GPT-6.1 Sol · service route — Request the GPT-6.1 Sol service route. This does not use your Codex subscription.
tvijo.agentModel.enum.7: Luna · service route — Request the Luna service route; unavailable routes are refused.
tvijo.agentMaxSteps.description: Default 60 tool steps. At the limit you can approve another 30, up to 200 total, within the same budget. Declining produces a bounded summary. DSH Harness uses its own host limits.
tvijo.agentBudgetUsd.description: Default $2 per local Agent task. At 80% usage the agent offers +$2, +$5 or +$10 for this run only. Nothing is added without your choice. Service/account limits still apply. DSH Harness keeps its original root budget.
tvijo.agentAutoRun.description: Skips per-command approval for literal allowlisted Agent commands. Plan refuses commands. Git transports also block fetch/clone in inherited environments. Commands run with your user's rights. Push is blocked for inherited environments; a program that rewrites its own environment is not stopped. Rules files changed by commands are quarantined, not prevented.
tvijo.agentAutoApply.description: Skips per-file approval for local Agent edits. Use when you can review opened diffs. Auto saves eligible edits to disk before checks; Plan refuses writes.
tvijo.telegram.enabled.description: Enables the owner-only Telegram connector on this extension host after bot configuration. Use only on a host that should run your bot. It requires a separately stored bot token and owner ID.
tvijo.telegram.ownerId.description: Legacy native value, not the active bot owner. Use Configure Telegram bot to set the owner for the signed-in account. The active owner is saved per account; changing this field alone does not transfer control. Bot tokens belong in SecretStorage.
tvijo.telegram.ownerId.deprecated: Use **Tvijo: Configure Telegram bot** to change the account-local owner.
tvijo.ocrLanguages.description: Choose installed Tesseract languages; English + Russian by default. Install missing language packs on the extension host. Screenshots provide extracted text to the selected model (ds41f by default), not pixels or visual layout.
tvijo.apiBase.description: Advanced: leave unchanged for Tvijo. Change only when your administrator supplies a trusted self-hosted endpoint. Changing the server switches account scope and requires signing in there.
tvijo.telegram.allowedServices.descripti: Allows exact systemd .service names for owner inspection/restart. Use only for explicitly selected services on the connector host. Empty disables service control; restart requires a fresh 60-second Telegram confirmation.
tvijo.autoCommit.description: After a successful Agent task, make a local Git commit of Tvijo’s own saved edits. Use when you want a checkpoint after each task. Files with staged or mixed user edits and quarantined rules are skipped. Git hooks run; cancellation can interrupt them. If a commit already exists, its result offers Undo. Changes to Git history or unexpected hook-added files stop automatic committing. Nothing is pushed.
tvijo.orchestration.enabled.description: Opt in to DSH Harness on the selected Linux local/Remote SSH project host. Existing engine remains the default. Requires explicit host setup; never installs packages or shares the operator subscription with website accounts.
tvijo.orchestration.profile.description: Fixed ds41f coordinator using the existing AIOS metered route. Chat model choices do not override this engine.
tvijo.orchestration.workerPolicy.descrip: Select only installed subscription workers: Sol; Sol + Astra for additional advice; Sol + Claude for a three-participant triad (ds41f coordinator, Sol implementation, Claude read-only review); or Sol + Astra + Claude with at least four roles after native Claude and quota verification. Selected-host subscriptions are separate from managed prepaid customer teams; the coordinator still uses its bounded service budget. For example, keep Sol when only Codex is set up. An unavailable selected worker stops the task; there is no secret billable API fallback. This policy selects workers, not the fixed coordinator service route.
tvijo.orchestration.controllerPath.descr: Advanced override: installed controller on the extension host disk (your computer locally, the remote machine in Remote SSH). Blank discovers the trusted host manifest after explicit setup. No background package installation. Use DSH doctor to check setup.
tvijo.orchestration.pythonPath.descripti: Advanced override: installed Python executable on the local or Remote SSH extension host disk, without shell arguments. Blank uses the trusted host manifest after explicit setup, then python3 if absent. No background package installation.
tvijo.orchestration.statePath.descriptio: Advanced override: durable queue and receipts on the extension host disk (local computer or Remote SSH machine). Private state uses 0700 owner-only access. Blank discovers the trusted host manifest after explicit setup. No background package installation.
tvijo.colorTheme.description: Choose accent colors for chat and settings. The six palettes work with both light and dark appearance. This does not change the rest of VS Code.
tvijo.commitIdentity.description: Git uses your configured name and email. Private uses a stable random local ID; Tvijo uses generic attribution. New automatic commits only. No email is hashed or uploaded; IDs are not registered on the website.
tvijo.orchestration.workerPolicy.enum.0: Sol · installed Codex subscription — Installed Sol subscription workers only. Unavailable stops; no billable fallback.
tvijo.orchestration.workerPolicy.enum.1: Sol + Astra · installed subscriptions — Installed Sol + Astra subscription workers only. Unavailable stops; no billable fallback.
tvijo.orchestration.workerPolicy.enum.2: Sol + Astra + verified Claude subscription — Installed Sol + Astra + verified native Claude subscriptions; at least 4 roles. Unavailable stops; no billable fallback.
tvijo.colorTheme.enum.0: Blue — chat and settings accent colors.
tvijo.colorTheme.enum.1: Violet — chat and settings accent colors.
tvijo.colorTheme.enum.2: Teal — chat and settings accent colors.
tvijo.colorTheme.enum.3: Amber — chat and settings accent colors.
tvijo.colorTheme.enum.4: Graphite — chat and settings accent colors.
tvijo.colorTheme.enum.5: Spectrum — chat and settings accent colors.
tvijo.orchestration.agentCount.descripti: Choose 3–6 team roles including the fixed ds41f coordinator, not simultaneous workers. Worker slots run sequentially: Sol implements first, then read-only Sol reviewers, with optional Astra/Claude advice under the selected policy. For example, 3 means one coordinator and two worker roles. Sol + Claude uses three participants: ds41f coordinator, Sol implementation and Claude read-only review; extra roles add Sol reviews. Sol + Astra + Claude needs at least 4. Requires a host runtime that advertises team options; unavailable selected workers stop without a paid API fallback.
tvijo.orchestration.reportFormat.descrip: Choose the host task report appearance: light, dark, rainbow, or both light and dark (default). This changes report output, not the six chat accent palettes, worker policy or task budget. For example, choose both to read the same report in either appearance. Requires a runtime that advertises team options.
tvijo.orchestrationReport.title: Open private task report
